Question: A year is a leap year if and only if the year number is divisible by \(400\) (such as \(2000\)) or is divisible by \(4\) but not \(100\) (such as \(2012\)). The \(200\)th anniversary of the birth of novelist Charles Dickens was celebrated on February \(7,\) \(2012,\) a Tuesday. On what day of the week was Dickens born?
